---
title: "Role Card: Senior Account Manager (Meridian)"
---

**Your side:** Meridian Analytics
**Your role:** Senior Account Manager

---

You're the one who faces the clients. If something goes wrong during this integration — a missed deadline, an unexpected change, anything that makes Meridian look disorganized — you're the one getting the call at 9 PM.

You are not opposed to change. But you have seen what happens when products are rushed to market without proper planning. Your threshold for acceptable risk is very low, and you will invoke the client relationship early and often. You need to know, before this meeting ends, that nothing in the new working norms will create client-facing surprises.

---
